name: qbs_node_count
description: 质量验评 QBS 树节点总数（含合同工程/单位工程/分部工程/单元工程各层级），源表 icms_quality_qbs，默认仅统计启用且已审核数据
formula: COUNT(fpim.icms_quality_qbs.id)

name: qbs_unit_eng_count
description: 单元工程（type=4）总数，验评统计的分母基数，源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_evaluated_count
description: 已完成验评的单元工程数（type=4 且验评结果为优良或合格），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_good_count
description: 验评结果为优良的单元工程数（type=4 且 result=1），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_qualified_count
description: 验评结果为合格的单元工程数（type=4 且 result=2），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_unevaluated_count
description: 尚未验评的单元工程数（type=4 且 result=3 或为空），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND (fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result = 3 OR fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_evaluated_rate
description: 已验评单元工程数 / 单元工程总数（0~1 小数，展示时转百分比），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

name: qbs_good_rate
description: 优良单元工程数 / 已验评单元工程数（0~1 小数，展示时转百分比），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

name: qbs_qualified_rate
description: 合格单元工程数 / 已验评单元工程数（0~1 小数，展示时转百分比；与优良率互补，两者之和为 100%），源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 4 AND fpim.icms_quality_qbs.result IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

name: qbs_unit_work_count
description: 单位工程（type=2）总数，源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: qbs_section_work_count
description: 分部工程（type=3）总数，源表 icms_quality_qbs
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_quality_qbs.type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_task_count
description: 进度计划 WBS 节点总数（含各层级），源表 icms_schedule_plan，默认仅统计启用且已审核数据
formula: COUNT(fpim.icms_schedule_plan.id)

name: plan_leaf_invest
description: 进度计划末级节点（if_last_level=1）投资金额合计（万元）；WBS 树父子层级均存投资金额，仅取末级避免重复累计，源表 icms_schedule_plan
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.if_last_level = 1 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.invest_price ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_leaf_work_num
description: 进度计划末级节点（if_last_level=1）工程数量合计，仅取末级避免父子层级重复累计，源表 icms_schedule_plan
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.if_last_level = 1 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.work_num ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_leaf_finish_work_num
description: 进度计划末级节点（if_last_level=1）已完成数量合计，仅取末级避免父子层级重复累计，源表 icms_schedule_plan
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.if_last_level = 1 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.finish_work_num ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_duration_avg
description: 草稿口径：进度计划原定工期算术平均（天，含各层级节点，树结构加权口径待业务确认）
formula: AVG(fpim.icms_schedule_plan.plan_duration)

name: plan_project_invest
description: 工程总投资（万元）：取总控计划根节点（level=1）的投资金额，全项目唯一；展示时可按需换算亿元
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.level = 1 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.invest_price ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_year_invest
description: 年度施工进度计划投资（万元）：取 level=2 年度根节点投资金额；查具体年份时用 plan_wbs_name 或 plan_full_path 过滤（如 '2026年施工进度计划'）
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.level = 2 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.invest_price ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_time_progress_rate
description: 计划完成比例 = 已历时工期 / 总工期（节点计划开始至计划完成，截至当前日期，截断在 0~1，仅取 level≤1/2 根节点）；查询时须用 plan_wbs_name 或 plan_full_path 锁定单个根节点（总控计划或年度计划）；0~1 小数，展示时转百分比
formula: MAX(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.level IN (1, 2) THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), fpim.icms_schedule_plan.plan_start_date) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(fpim.icms_schedule_plan.plan_end_date, fpim.icms_schedule_plan.plan_start_date), 0))) ELSE 0 END)

name: plan_actual_finish_rate
description: 实际完成比例 = 子树内末级节点已完成估投合计 / 根节点投资；**必须**用 plan_full_path contains 锚定年度根节点（如 '/2026年施工进度计划'，不带尾斜杠，否则会漏掉根节点自身）；不带年度锚定的全局口径依赖反馈明细表（尚未迁入），禁止无过滤使用；0~1 小数，展示时转百分比
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.if_last_level = 1 THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.finish_estimate ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.level IN (1, 2) THEN fpim.icms_schedule_plan.invest_price ELSE 0 END), 0)

name: invest_finish_month
description: 月度投资执行单当月完成投资合计（万元）；按 year/month/单位汇总；注意与计划表已完成估投（finish_estimate）为两套独立口径，数值不一致属正常；源表 icms_invest_monthly
formula: SUM(fpim.icms_invest_monthly.finish_price)

name: hazard_count
description: 危险源台账记录总数（含已解除确认），源表 icms_project_hazard
formula: COUNT(fpim.icms_project_hazard.id)

name: hazard_confirmed_count
description: 当前确认在册（confirm_status=1，未解除确认）的危险源数；用户问“现在/当前有多少危险源”时用此指标
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_project_hazard.confirm_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: hazard_major_count
description: 重大危险源（type=1）数量，源表 icms_project_hazard
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_project_hazard.type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

name: hazard_general_count
description: 一般危险源（type=3）数量，源表 icms_project_hazard
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fpim.icms_project_hazard.type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
